pre-event-cho.label: Carbohydrate in the pre-event meal
pre-event-cho.value: 1–4 g·kg⁻¹ body mass, eaten 1–4 h before the start

cho-during-guidelines.label: Carbohydrate during exercise, by duration
cho-during-guidelines.value: about 1 h: a mouth rinse or small amounts; 1–2.5 h: 30–60 g·h⁻¹; over 2.5 h: up to 90 g·h⁻¹ (glucose + fructose)

glucose-oxidation-max.label: Highest exogenous oxidation rate of glucose (or maltodextrin) alone
glucose-oxidation-max.value: about 1 g·min⁻¹ (60 g·h⁻¹), set by absorption in the gut

mtc-oxidation-max.label: Highest exogenous oxidation rate with glucose + fructose
